publication.rule: Every maintainer must route verified public-safe fixes into the public release. Atomic maintainers hand off publication to General; General alone generates, audits and pushes the allowlisted public projection. Private-instance and private-persona changes remain local.

local_deployment.rule: A code maintenance change is not operationally complete until verification passes and the dashboard health build_id matches the current checkout. The command may replace only a process verified as Thula-owned.

rule: Evaluate scope before execution. Atomic work stays with its owner; mixed or unknown scope defers to General. General may perform global or atomic maintenance.
